pipeline.binding_refusal: completeness: module refusals with reason insufficient_operands / no_valid_evidence bind the final answer to abstention
pipeline.guard_semantics: guards only convert answer -> abstention, never invent or alter an answer value; identifier_extraction replaces a bare-integer answer with the single identifier stated in the reader's own cited record (receipt logged)
pipeline.operand_completion: v2: unique (person, scope, predicate) key from reader citations; same-key context pool; explicit-year restriction; same-event dedupe; per-record audit receipts
pipeline.prefilter: prefilter_v2 (R1 validity-expired, R2 correction-conflict-only, R3 superseded-by-version-relation)
pipeline.routing: pattern_first (deterministic question patterns first, reader qtype as fallback)

reader.loading: bitsandbytes 4-bit nf4, compute fp16, device_map single GPU
reader.user_payload: JSON {question, question_date, memory} (identical to the v1 hybrid kernel)

stage: V6.3 stage 1 (V6.2 safety hardening of the V6 hybrid prototype)
